_doc: ONE registry of every claude.ai artifact we keep (replaces manifest.json, 2026-10-12). Pages are published from the repo copy over the SAME url on each account, so the link stays current and the pin stays. A session cannot delete or unpin: retire/duplicate rows are the list Jis cleans by hand. Check: python scripts/dev/artifacts.py check. Procedure: artifacts/README.md.

accounts.jishu.awgp: second account, JIS-NUC (Jis calls it the NB-app list with 6 pins)
accounts.jishu.sharma: first account, JIS-NB (3 pins: Control Room, CBP Desk, CBP Monday Desk)

pages.title: MTS Control Room
pages.owner_app: either; each account has its own db (Inbox, decisions) - see note
pages.note: Two dbs: an answer typed on one account is invisible on the other. Decision q1-one-control-room (2026-10-13, acted on under the operator blanket go, he can overrule on the page): the jishu.awgp page is the one place for questions and Inbox; the jishu.sharma page is a view and its old decisions need one JIS-NB session to copy them into system/OPERATOR_DECISIONS.md. Now also carries the Claude-GPT cycle section (system/RELAY_NOTES.md).
